markets.rules_secondary:
The Underlying is Colorado Ski Country USA’s projected statewide skier-visit total for the 2026–27 ski season. A skier visit represents one person visiting a ski area for all or any part of one day. The figure covers statewide Colorado ski-area visitation and is not limited to Colorado Ski Country USA member resorts.

This market uses the first Colorado Ski Country USA statewide estimate for the 2026–27 season; subsequent revisions do not affect resolution.

Resolution compares 2026–27 projected statewide skier visits against a fixed 10.5 million baseline from the 2025–26 projected total. Later revisions do not change the strike.

markets.rules_primary: If the bloc of the People's Party and Vox has won at least 50 seats in the next Valencian regional election, then the market resolves to Yes.
markets.rules_secondary:
A seat is considered "won" when a candidate affiliated with the specified party has been declared elected by the relevant electoral authority and either:
The time for legal challenges has expired
Challenges have been resolved
The member has taken their seat

Party affiliation is determined by the party under whose banner the candidate was elected, regardless of subsequent changes. The count is determined when the new legislature takes their seats, even if some seats remain vacant or challenged. If the election is postponed beyond one year from the original date or cancelled entirely, the market resolves to the last fair market price. Only seats actually contested and filled are counted in partial elections. By-elections after the main election are included only if seated simultaneously with the rest of the legislature.

The bloc's seat total is the combined number of seats won by the People's Party and Vox. Post-election coalitions and investiture agreements do not change the total. The next Valencian regional election means the first election to the Corts Valencianes held after this market opens, whether on the scheduled date or earlier.

markets.early_close_condition: This market will close and expire early if the official vote count is certified.
markets.rules_primary: If at least 45,000,000 ballots are cast in the June 6, 2027 Mexican federal election for the Chamber of Deputies, then the market resolves to Yes.
markets.rules_secondary:
The count is the total number of ballots cast (votos emitidos) in the federal Chamber of Deputies election, as reported in the national participation statistics of the Instituto Nacional Electoral's district counts (cómputos distritales), including valid ballots, ballots for unregistered candidates and null ballots. The count includes ballots from special polling stations as reflected in that national total. Registered voters, abstentions and ballots in other contests do not count.

Subject to the contract’s Fully-Conducted Elections and accelerated determination provisions for designated media declarations, the vote count refers to the officially certified results from the relevant election authority. Provisional, absentee, early, mail-in, or electronic ballots are included if, and only if, they are reflected in the official certification (or in the Fully-Conducted unofficial results where that provision applies).

The contract resolves based on officially certified results regardless of ongoing appeals. Outside those two contract provisions, preliminary counts, exit polls, projections, or uncertified results do not qualify. If the election is postponed but held within one year of the originally scheduled date, the contract remains valid. If postponed beyond one year or canceled before voting is fully conducted, all contracts resolve to No.
markets.title: Will at least 45,000,000 ballots be cast in Mexico’s June 6, 2027 Chamber of Deputies election?

A coalition's candidate is the candidate it registers with the Central Election Commission (KQZ) for the Tirana mayoral election, or an independent candidate that the listed party in it (the Socialist Party, the Democratic Party or Lëvizja Bashkë) publicly declares as its own candidate before the KQZ candidate-registration deadline. A registered party that a listed party merges into counts as that party. markets.rules_primary: If Democrats for Andorra wins the next Andorran parliamentary election, then the market resolves to Yes.
markets.rules_secondary:
Each market is the named party together with every electoral list that includes it. A list includes a party if the party is named in the list's official name or candidacy registration published by the Government of Andorra.

Seats are counted across both ballots: the 14 seats elected from the national list and the 14 seats elected from the parish lists. Every seat won by a list that includes the party counts for that party, whichever party the individual councillor belongs to. If a list includes more than one party named in these markets, its seats count only for the first of them in this order: Democrats for Andorra, Concòrdia, Andorra Endavant, Social Democratic Party.

For parliamentary/legislative elections, the winner is the party, coalition, or alliance winning the most seats in the specified chamber. If two parties have the same number of seats, the one with the higher share of the vote will resolve to Yes and all others to No. Share of the vote means the share of valid national-list votes won by the lists that include the party.

This market is eligible for accelerated resolution by a consensus of media calls. See full rules for details.

markets.rules_primary: If a Tennessee statute or Metro Nashville ordinance that caps, freezes, reduces, or funds payment of Metro Nashville–Davidson County property taxes on commercial real property is enacted in Tennessee before Jun 1, 2027, then the market resolves to Yes.
markets.rules_secondary:
Enactment requires completion of all constitutional and legal requirements for the legislation to become binding law.

Standard legislation requiring executive approval: final passage by all required legislative bodies, executive signature OR becoming law despite executive inaction OR successful veto override, and satisfaction of any required waiting periods
Legislation not requiring executive approval: final passage and completion of required waiting periods
Constitutional amendments: passage with required supermajorities and completion of ratification processes
Executive orders: official signature, publication in official government records, and legal effectiveness

The following do NOT constitute enactment:

Legislative passage without completed executive action
Passage by only some required bodies
Provisional passage
Non-binding resolutions
Draft orders

Enactment occurs when all requirements are completed, regardless of pending judicial challenges.

Note: This event was issued before the September 14, 2026 amendment to the LAW Contract, so that amendment does not apply. To be clear, a law must take legal effect before this event’s deadline; a law enacted before the deadline whose effective date falls on or after it does not satisfy the Payout Criterion.

markets.rules_primary: If University of Florida wins the Overall Performance title at the 2027 Student Steel Bridge Competition National Finals, then the market resolves to Yes.
markets.rules_secondary:
The Student Steel Bridge Competition challenges college teams to design and fabricate a steel bridge, assemble it under timed conditions, and undergo load testing. The American Institute of Steel Construction (AISC) organizes the National Finals in collaboration with the American Society of Civil Engineers (ASCE).

This market concerns the Overall Performance national title. Regional championships, individual category awards, and special awards do not count as winning this title. Under the 2027 rules, the lowest combined construction cost, structural cost, and applicable fines wins overall; aesthetics breaks ties. The official National Finals results determine the winner.

Schools must satisfy the competition's eligibility and qualification requirements. Ordinary advancement is through regional results; AISC and ASCE may authorize replacements or additional invitations. Regional guest status alone does not establish National Finals eligibility.

Kalshi is not affiliated, associated, authorized, endorsed by, or in any way officially connected with the American Institute of Steel Construction or the American Society of Civil Engineers. All trademarks, logos, and brand names are the property of their respective owners.

markets.early_close_condition: This market will close and expire early if certified election results are published.
markets.rules_primary: If the margin of victory for Mary Peltola in the 2026 Alaska Senate election falls within 0% to 3%, inclusive of its lower bound and exclusive of its upper bound, then the market resolves to Yes.
markets.rules_secondary:
Important information: the margin shall be calculated using the results from the final round of tabulation.

"Dan Sullivan" refers to Daniel S. Sullivan, the incumbent Senator.

Each margin range is inclusive of its lower bound and exclusive of its upper bound. No rounding shall be applied to the calculated margin. For example, for consecutive ranges of 5-6% and 6-7%, a margin of 5.99999% resolves within the 5-6% range, while a margin of exactly 6% resolves within the 6-7% range. If Mary Peltola runs under multiple parties or is listed multiple times, votes attributable to the same underlying natural Mary Peltola will be summed.

If Mary Peltola wins the election, the margin will be positive. If Mary Peltola loses the election, the margin will be negative. If Mary Peltola ties for first place, the margin shall be 0. For uncontested races where Mary Peltola is the only candidate, the margin shall be 100 percentage points or the total number of votes cast (for raw votes).

markets.early_close_condition: This market will close and expire early if the event occurs.
markets.rules_primary: If the U.S. District Court for the Northern District of California orders Meta Platforms, Inc. to pay the plaintiff States $10 billion or more in total monetary relief in the state attorney general actions in In re Social Media Adolescent Addiction/Personal Injury Products Liability Litigation, No. 4:22-md-03047 before Jul 1, 2027, then the market resolves to Yes.
markets.rules_secondary:
This market turns on money ordered, not on liability. The advisory jury's verdict is not a ruling of the court, so only a written order, opinion, judgment or decision issued by the court counts.

Monetary relief means civil penalties, restitution, disgorgement and any payment into an abatement or remediation fund, added together across every plaintiff State and every claim in these actions. Amounts ordered in two or more orders are aggregated. Attorneys' fees and costs are NOT counted. A later reduction on post-trial motion or on appeal does not reverse a YES.

The following do NOT satisfy the Payout Criterion:
Injunctive relief, however broad, including an order to change Facebook or Instagram or to delete data, algorithms or models
The June 2026 summary judgment ruling on parental consent, which ordered no payment
A settlement of any size, or a voluntary dismissal
Oral rulings from the bench unless reduced to a written order
Tentative rulings that are not made final
Administrative or scheduling orders
Awards in the personal injury, school district or other actions in this multidistrict litigation

markets.early_close_condition: This market will close and expire early if the company makes the specified announcement.
markets.rules_primary: If Tesla or SpaceX officially announces a definitive, binding agreement for Tesla to acquire SpaceX, SpaceX to acquire Tesla, or the two entities to merge or combine in any structure that results in a transfer of controlling interest or consolidation of the two entities under common corporate ownership before Oct 1, 2026, then the market resolves to Yes.
markets.rules_secondary:
The announcement must be made through official company channels including press releases, SEC filings (8-K, 10-K, 10-Q), earnings calls, investor presentations, verified social media accounts, or official statements to media subsequently confirmed by the company. CEO statements through official channels qualify. Rumors, speculation, unconfirmed reports, leaked information, third-party announcements without company confirmation, and preliminary discussions do not qualify. The announcement must occur after market issuance. Companies are tracked through rebranding and name changes representing the same business entity.

This market resolves Yes regardless of which entity is the acquirer and which is the target. A Tesla acquisition of SpaceX, a SpaceX acquisition of Tesla, a reverse merger, or a stock-for-stock combination all satisfy the Payout Criterion equally, provided a definitive agreement is publicly announced.

A statement by Elon Musk shall only satisfy the Payout Criterion if it constitutes an unambiguous, affirmative confirmation of a definitive signed agreement — not an expression of intent, a hypothetical, a negotiation update, or a speculative comment about a future combination.
markets.title: Will Tesla or SpaceX announce a definitive, binding agreement for Tesla to acquire SpaceX, SpaceX to acquire Tesla, or the two entities to merge or combine in any structure that results in a transfer of controlling interest or consolidation of the two entities under common corporate ownership before Oct 1, 2026?

markets.rules_primary: If Tesla or SpaceX officially announces a definitive, binding agreement for Tesla to acquire SpaceX, SpaceX to acquire Tesla, or the two entities to merge or combine in any structure that results in a transfer of controlling interest or consolidation of the two entities under common corporate ownership before Nov 1, 2026, then the market resolves to Yes.
markets.rules_secondary:
The announcement must be made through official company channels including press releases, SEC filings (8-K, 10-K, 10-Q), earnings calls, investor presentations, verified social media accounts, or official statements to media subsequently confirmed by the company. CEO statements through official channels qualify. Rumors, speculation, unconfirmed reports, leaked information, third-party announcements without company confirmation, and preliminary discussions do not qualify. The announcement must occur after market issuance. Companies are tracked through rebranding and name changes representing the same business entity.

This market resolves Yes regardless of which entity is the acquirer and which is the target. A Tesla acquisition of SpaceX, a SpaceX acquisition of Tesla, a reverse merger, or a stock-for-stock combination all satisfy the Payout Criterion equally, provided a definitive agreement is publicly announced.

A statement by Elon Musk shall only satisfy the Payout Criterion if it constitutes an unambiguous, affirmative confirmation of a definitive signed agreement — not an expression of intent, a hypothetical, a negotiation update, or a speculative comment about a future combination.

No contracts pay $1 minus the Yes payout.
If the league officially uses a tiebreaker to determine a single top goalscorer, the market resolves based on the league's official winner.

markets.no_sub_title: French president: Marine Le Pen, EUR/USD change: below -3%
markets.rules_primary: If ALL of the following occur: French president: Marine Le Pen, EUR/USD change: below -3%, then the market resolves to Yes.
markets.rules_secondary:
For all outcomes in this market, French president refers to the person first elected President of France in the 2027 presidential election, and EUR/USD change refers to the percent change in the Pyth Network FX.EUR/USD price from the start time to the end time. "Not Marine Le Pen" means that a person other than Marine Le Pen is elected.

The start time is 4:00 PM ET on the last Friday before the first round of the election. The end time is 10:00 AM ET on the first Monday after the second round, or after the first round if a candidate is elected in it. If the first round is held on Apr 18, 2027 and the second round on May 2, 2027, the start time is Apr 16, 2027 at 4:00 PM ET and the end time is May 3, 2027 at 10:00 AM ET. The percent change is (end price - start price) / start price x 100, using each Pyth price rounded to four decimal places, and is not rounded further. Each range includes its lower bound and excludes its upper bound. For example, "-3% to -1%" includes -3% but not -1%, and "3% or above" includes 3%.

This is a combination market requiring ALL specified outcomes to occur for the contract to pay out. If ANY single component resolves to No or becomes impossible, the entire contract immediately resolves to No. Each component is resolved according to its corresponding Kalshi ruleset: French president (FRENCHPRES), EUR/USD change (FXEURUSD). The Pyth price refers to the aggregate price only, and no averaging or carry-forward of stale prices applies. Revisions published after expiration will not be considered. If no President has been elected or the end time has not occurred before this market closes, every market resolves to No.
